description: Source code defining classes and methods for sale and packing journals in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including invoice types, sale journals, and packing journals with workflow actions.

classes.name: sale_journal_invoice_type
classes.description: Defines invoice types with attributes like name, active status, note, and invoicing method.

classes.name: sale_journal
classes.description: Represents a sale journal with attributes such as name, code, responsible user, dates, state, and associated sale stats. Includes workflow methods for canceling, confirming, opening, drafting, and closing.

classes.name: picking_journal
classes.description: Represents a packing journal with attributes like name, code, responsible user, dates, state, and associated journal stats. Includes workflow methods for canceling, opening, drafting, and closing.

methods.name: button_sale_cancel
methods.description: Cancels draft sale orders linked to the sale journal.

methods.name: button_sale_confirm
methods.description: Confirms draft sale orders linked to the sale journal.

methods.name: button_open
methods.description: Sets the journal state to open.

methods.name: button_draft
methods.description: Sets the journal state to draft.

methods.name: button_close
methods.description: Marks the journal as done and sets validation date.

methods.name: button_picking_cancel
methods.description: Cancels stock pickings linked to the packing journal.

methods.name: button_open
methods.description: Sets the packing journal state to open.

methods.name: button_draft
methods.description: Sets the packing journal state to draft.

methods.name: button_close
methods.description: Marks the packing journal as done and sets validation date.
